Name: Earthy Recolor - Missing Assets for Various Mods

And just to note: No AI is used just me and Aseprite

Installation:
This is a replacement mod so all files will overwrite the originals. Make a backup if you'd like.
[list]
[*][b]Manually:[/b]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Manually download the file
[*]Extract the folder
[*]Paste the folders you want into your mod folder
[*]Overwrite all files
[/list][list]
[*][b]Vortex [/b](if it works properly that is)
[/list][list=1]
[*]Install via Vortex
[*]Overwrite everything with this mod
[*]Deploy
[/list]Note that SMAPI will through errors for any mod that you don't have but these are safe to ignore.
